rubric: public-app rubric across security, mathematical correctness, product depth, UX, feedback, engagement, AI/capability control, performance, maintainability, and launch truth

sample.method: Startup evidence, release-gate replay, capability-boundary tracing, public-claim search, untested-module inventory, local-storage contract scan, commerce/referral path tracing, and focused review of Live Scanner, feature flags, calculator scoring, profile inference, gift delivery, and public surfaces.

premiseLedger.baseline: Recovery checkpoint b3fac02 is on origin/main. Direct launch-local passed 97/97 test files and 679/679 assertions, 52 Edge checks, Doctor 12/12 with blockingFailing 0, and 20 objective Chromium captures.
premiseLedger.releaseLens: FORGE remains an honest launch HOLD. Stable staging, delivered headers, Obelisk/Zoho, provider deployment, historical credential remediation, real user journeys, and founder approval remain external evidence boundaries.
liveContradictions: resolveFlag permits a remote enabled row to turn on provider-backed or paid capabilities even when the build-time launch ceiling is false.
Live Scanner renders time-derived opportunity counts as live activity and estimates fair probability by averaging vig-loaded implied probabilities including the target quote.
Referral surfaces promise 30 free days with no limit while gift-trial enforces 14 recipient days, 7 sender days, and five gifts per 30 days; delivery failure is swallowed while the UI says sent.
Calculator-use frequency is labeled as specialist skill and success without realized-outcome evidence.
Juice Score maps heuristics to EXCELLENT/GOOD PLAY labels without exposing basis, assumptions, or evidence confidence.

items.title: Make remote rollout flags subtractive so provider and commerce capabilities cannot exceed the audited build ceiling
items.axis: security / capability control / AI / commerce truth
items.executionEvidence: Typed subtractive decisions now require the audited build ceiling before remote tier/cohort rollout. Five protected consumers have no raw FEATURE_FLAGS bypass; 11 focused policy/consumer checks pass.
items.why: A stale or compromised feature_flags row can currently expose paid checkout, live odds, push, or AI surfaces even when the deployment explicitly built them disabled.
evidence: src/lib/featureFlags.js returns true for remote enabled rows without requiring FEATURE_FLAGS[key].
src/launchState.js defaults all eight provider-backed capabilities to false.
No focused feature-flag test covers remote broadening, cohort boundaries, or malformed tiers.
items.recipe: Create a typed flag decision receipt. Require the immutable build ceiling before any remote rollout can enable a protected capability; let remote state only narrow enabled builds. Preserve cohort/tier controls, expose reason codes to UI callers, and add adversarial tests for stale, malformed, unauthenticated, and percentage-cohort rows.

items.title: Replace simulated liveness and vig-loaded +EV estimates with source-counted, target-excluded quote evidence
items.axis: feature depth / mathematical correctness / observability / UX
items.executionEvidence: Scanner +EV now requires fresh target-excluded no-vig consensus from at least two distinct bookmaker identities, with reason/grade/source receipts. Time-seeded activity and checkout-shaped trial copy were removed; five adversarial math tests pass.
items.why: The scanner's locked state fabricates activity from the clock, while its +EV engine includes the target book in its own benchmark and never removes market vig.
evidence: src/components/LiveScanner.jsx derives locked opportunity counts from hour/minute arithmetic.
detectEV averages raw 1/decimal probabilities across books, including the candidate book.
No test imports or exercises Live Scanner quote analysis.
items.recipe: Extract a pure quote-evidence engine. Build paired outcome markets per source, normalize each source to no-vig probabilities, exclude the target source, require multiple independent comparison books, return evidence count/freshness/quality/reason codes, and suppress unsupported +EV. Replace locked-state counts and checkout-shaped trial copy with capability-derived availability.

items.title: Unify referral and gift terms around delivery-aware receipts instead of contradictory reward promises
items.executionEvidence: Canonical UI terms disclose 14 recipient days, a 7-day sender-credit attempt, and five gifts per rolling 30 days. Edge receipts distinguish token issuance, provider acceptance, inbox uncertainty, and sender-credit persistence; Edge verification and four focused tests pass.
items.why: The UI claims 30 free days with no limit, the actual function issues 14 recipient days and 7 sender days with a five-gift limit, and email failure is swallowed while the UI says sent.
evidence: ReferralHub.jsx contains mutually incompatible 30-day and 14/7-day rewards.
gift-trial enforces five gifts per 30 days and awards sender metadata during issuance.
The Resend call catches and discards failure; GiftTrialBox renders Gift sent for every successful token response.
items.recipe: Add one referral-terms contract shared by UI and tests. Make the Edge response distinguish token-issued, provider-accepted, provider-unconfigured, and provider-rejected delivery. Remove invented earned-day totals, disclose limits and provider-gated features, avoid exposing sender email in gift copy, label the email input, and test every receipt state.

items.title: Turn the usage-derived play persona into an evidence-labeled tool-mix observation
items.executionEvidence: Usage history now yields a typed tool-mix observation with sample, distribution, dominance, limited confidence, and a non-performance disclaimer. Sparse/tied/malformed/dominant cases pass.
items.why: Three calculator uses can currently label someone a specialist who excels, despite no outcome, calibration, or execution evidence.
evidence: userProfile.js infers skill labels from pg_hist_* counts only.
Copy promises maximum bankroll growth and pure modeled profit.
ActivationNextAction renders the inference as Your Play Style without a basis disclosure.
items.recipe: Return a typed observation with sample count, distribution, dominance threshold, confidence, and explicit non-performance disclaimer. Use neutral tool-mix labels, route to review/learning rather than action pressure, and test sparse, tied, malformed, and dominant histories.

items.title: Replace authoritative Juice Score play grades with assumption-bound model-signal receipts
items.axis: decision safety / feature depth / UX / public claims
items.executionEvidence: Three calculators now render basis-specific assumption-bound model receipts instead of EXCELLENT/GOOD PLAY grades; action-promoting SGP/teaser copy was replaced and focused receipt tests pass.
items.why: Heuristic transforms currently become EXCELLENT PLAY and GOOD PLAY labels, implying validation the calculator does not possess.
evidence: juiceScore.js maps modeled conversion/ROI/edge into an unexplained 0-100 scale.
SGP, teaser, and three-way arb pass materially different assumptions through the same unlabeled score.
items.recipe: Emit a typed signal receipt with score, basis, interpretation, assumption, confidence, and non-outcome label. Render the receipt accessibly, pass calculator-specific bases, remove action-promoting language, and add cross-calculator tests plus a durable public-claim rule.

secondOrderCandidates.executionEvidence: Five low-false-positive claim rules plus a structural clock-derived market-count rule now block simulated liveness, collapsed delivery, usage-as-performance, authoritative play grades, and unbounded referral rewards. Full 334-file scan passes 25 rules.
secondOrderCandidates.why: The existing public-claim scanner catches legal and earnings absolutes but missed simulated liveness, unproved delivery, usage-as-skill, and heuristic play grades.
secondOrderCandidates.recipe: Add low-false-positive document rules and fixtures for each repaired claim class, then scan the full public surface.

secondOrderCandidates.executionEvidence: Saturation review found two compound-proof seams: duplicate rows from one bookmaker could satisfy an independent-source threshold, and sender metadata failure was swallowed. Both now fail closed with focused tests and typed UI/Edge receipts.
secondOrderCandidates.why: Evidence count and reward truth are only valid when identity and persistence semantics are explicit.
secondOrderCandidates.recipe: Deduplicate consensus by source identity and report sender credit only after confirmed metadata persistence.

secondOrderCandidates.executionEvidence: Twenty-four exact Chromium PNGs cover six touched surfaces in dark/light and desktop/mobile; all hashes are unique, all browser assertions and pixel gates pass, and LATEST.json binds the bytes.
secondOrderCandidates.why: Decision-language changes require rendered-state proof, not source-only review.
secondOrderCandidates.recipe: Seed deterministic evidence states, assert copy and overflow in-browser, audit exact pixels, and compile one hash-bound receipt.

secondOrderCandidates.why: Studio conformance findField accepts only numeric fields, so CANON-045 cannot read the checker's boolean pass field.
secondOrderCandidates.recipe: Ship a signed Ark defect report to studio-ops; do not edit the sibling directly.

rejected.reason: Rejected: these are external facts and require redacted observed receipts.

rejected.reason: Rejected: CANON-018 requires Ark transport and owner-side writeback.
